manifest.title: A signed validator upgrade and a more observable network.
manifest.summary: This week brought a signed Genesis-4 validator upgrade, richer explorer and infrastructure telemetry, and stricter readiness checks across the L2, DEX, bridge and wallet. The latter integrations remain gated; source activity is not evidence of public activation.
highlights: A signed Linux x86-64 validator upgrade and verification files were published on 22 September for existing synchronized Genesis-4 nodes.
Bloch Explorer now exposes transaction flows, epoch and validator views, observability telemetry, and a live count of peer connections reported by monitored nodes.
L2, DEX, bridge and wallet work added fail-closed evidence and activation gates; public native settlement, pools and bridge operations remain unqualified.

tracks.name: Node & consensus
tracks.current: A signed Linux x86-64 upgrade binary from source commit dade5a33 was published on 22 September for existing synchronized Genesis-4 nodes. It is an upgrade artifact, not a fresh-bootstrap bundle.
tracks.next: Document rollout and mixed-version evidence, preserve prior binaries for rollback, and publish a fresh independently verified checkpoint and bootstrap bundle before new-node installation guidance is advanced.
tracks.evidence: The public release includes a signed SHA-256 manifest, build provenance and upgrade instructions. The release record does not by itself establish fleet-wide rollout or a recovery SLA.

tracks.name: Explorer & indexer
tracks.current: The live explorer adds navigable transaction flows, epoch timelines, validator activity, mempool observer comparisons, and Grafana-backed chain, host and Kubernetes telemetry. A second globe visualizes reported peer connections.
tracks.next: Extend historical indexer coverage and distinguish unique network peers from repeated connection reports; retain source-freshness and corroboration labels.
tracks.evidence: The explorer deployment and public observability endpoint were checked on 23 September. Peer totals sum connections reported by active monitored nodes, not unique machines.

tracks.name: EVM execution
tracks.current: The experimental EVM gained a fail-closed production-entrypoint contract, lifecycle receipts, provenance checks and an offline frozen-genesis ceremony workflow for chain 700771.
tracks.next: Complete a real production node build, independently approve and freeze genesis, then qualify settlement, finality and state restoration end to end.
tracks.evidence: Reviewed the L2 README and 22 September source history. Its production delivery remains incomplete; synthetic entrypoint checks are not a launched L2.

tracks.name: DEX & native pools
tracks.current: PosternDEX retains its external-EVM interface. New pilot pool caps, semantic launch evidence and aggregate readiness checks are observation-only; native pool activation remains hard gated.
tracks.next: Authenticate a finalized deployment snapshot and custody roles, finish restart and reorg qualification, and obtain independent review before enabling native pools.
tracks.evidence: Reviewed the DEX README and 20–22 September commits. The repository makes no production network, router or native-pool activation claim.

tracks.name: Bridge & stablecoins
tracks.current: The bridge added offline authority ceremony tooling, detached-signature handling, anchored reviewer trust inputs and durable observation checkpoints. These checks do not authorize minting or release.
tracks.next: Complete independent authority approval, production finality and custody qualification, and reconciliation of backing and redemptions before public native deposits.
tracks.evidence: Reviewed the bridge README and 21–22 September commits. Its readiness composer remains non-authorizing and no public native bridge service is claimed.

tracks.name: Wallet & aggregator
tracks.current: The published wallet continues to support its existing external-EVM routes. Product release logic now orders authenticated L2, bridge and DEX component gates and fails closed when evidence is missing.
tracks.next: Qualify the intended route and asset matrix, receipt-bound recovery, and authenticated component releases before enabling native Bloch aggregation.
tracks.evidence: Reviewed the wallet README and 22 September release-gate commits. The new gates are source work, not proof that native Bloch execution is live.

roadmap.title: Qualify the signed validator upgrade rollout
roadmap.detail: Collect mixed-version, canary, rollback and recovery evidence for the 22 September upgrade; keep new-node bootstrap separate.

roadmap.title: Renew trusted bootstrap guidance
roadmap.detail: Publish and independently verify a current checkpoint and complete bundle, then measure Linux cold sync and restart resource limits.

roadmap.title: Connect EVM execution to native settlement
roadmap.detail: Freeze chain 700771 genesis with independent approval, build the production node and qualify authenticated state/finality beyond local execution.

roadmap.title: Complete native DEX and bridge integration
roadmap.detail: Keep activation gates closed until custody, reserve/liability accounting, replay protection, finality, reorg recovery and independent approval are verified.

roadmap.title: Qualify wallet and aggregator delivery
roadmap.detail: Verify supported networks and assets, quote execution, rejection paths, receipt-based recovery and authenticated component gates.

roadmap.title: Maintain signed artifacts and operator evidence
roadmap.detail: Preserve the signed upgrade, publish dated rollout evidence and rollback instructions, and coordinate independent validators.
